title: Add Scene Domain Prop
description: Add a new board scene prop for domain, default it to architecture, and use it to derive or constrain features such as LOD according to the provided domain-specific scale ladders. Update implementation and existing tests as needed.
summary: Fixed scene LOD calibration for meter-based scenes by deriving domain thresholds with the same distance reference used by runtime pseudo-zoom, so architectural scenes are classified by real camera distance instead of mismatched arbitrary constants. Added unit coverage for the calibrated architecture ladder and end-to-end coverage asserting the play example loads as an architecture scene in overview LOD. Verified with scene unit tests, build, and the full Playwright scene suite.
